perf-control-324-stage-calls.unit: primitive calls in the homesteads stage under cProfile, the clone (feature 324) - equal to the base engine's
perf-control-324-stage-calls.quantity: alternated base (/tmp/base324 at 8c61b03ae) and clone, two runs each, 2026-10-05 01:0x, load 7-10: homesteads base 3,403,625 / 3,403,780 calls in 3.971 / 4.179 s, clone 3,403,625 / 3,403,625 in 3.770 / 3.821 s; web base 3,082,228 / 3,082,225 in 2.767 / 2.860 s, clone 3,082,225 / 3,082,225 in 2.479 / 2.309 s. The stages execute the same code (the base's own runs differ by warm-up calls); the snapshot times only the roll's stages, and feature 324 changes the picture's render (raster.py) and the render step (render_cache.py), neither run by a roll stage. Whole-snapshot alternation under the same load was inconclusive (15 households: base 43.0 / 22.3 s, clone 33.1 / 25.9 s).
